responsibility: Declares the item-level typecheckers for extern blocks and impl blocks in the Rust frontend. It provides TypeCheckTopLevelExternItem for resolving extern declarations, TypeCheckImplItem for inherent impl members, and TypeCheckImplItemWithTrait for trait impl members that must be matched and validated against a resolved trait item predicate.
same_name_distinction: Declares the three impl-related checkers—TypeCheckTopLevelExternItem, TypeCheckImplItem, and TypeCheckImplItemWithTrait—and their entry points, separating interface from implementation. The corresponding rust-hir-type-check-implitem.cc performs the actual extern resolution, impl-member checking, and trait-member validation.
